sections.what_happened: Reuters and JPost both carry the WSJ report that Putin proposed a Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral on Ukraine at APEC Shenzhen, without Zelensky, in the Oct 9 call that also yielded the diesel deal; JPost adds Peskov quote ('no clear understanding yet regarding the meeting itself or its potential agenda'). Reuters timestamps its carry 2026-10-19 05:13 ( ) — in-window corroboration. Nothing from Trump, Xi or Beijing agreeing.
sections.what_verified: WSJ (anonymous: former Russian intelligence officer + people familiar), Peskov (Kremlin: discussions ongoing), US official (Trump 'could be receptive'), Reuters wire carry, JPost carry, SCMP Sept track (concept predates)
sections.what_disputed: Anonymous WSJ sourcing; no confirmation from Trump/Xi/Beijing; Kyiv and European allies would reject a settlement negotiated without Ukraine; SCMP shows the trilateral idea has been floated since September (only the Oct-9-call specificity is new); could be a trial balloon.
sections.why_matters: Great-power diplomacy as the off-ramp; report as floated proposal, not done deal; label every layer honestly.
sections.context: Background: Corroboration update — Reuters wire and JPost independently carry the WSJ trilateral-summit report (0400-01); verification upgraded Partially supported -> Strongly supported
